sources.title: 《元史》卷52《昼夜刻》元授時歷北京冬夏至刻位資料

sources.quality_notes: Records winter Beijing sunrise 辰初二刻 / summer sunset 戌初二刻, and 62-ke solstitial day/night. Same numeric totals do not prove equal clock coordinate, transmission to CText, or parity with the 1447 Peng Deqing proposal.
